observations: The overview has three side-by-side panels: a CT-like papyrus image and two coloured probability overlays. The paper contains fibres, prominent cracks/holes, and several bright model response groups distributed near the upper and lower edges and toward the right.
The two overlays differ in coverage and intensity at several locations. This is a public model comparison with existing responses, not a raw probability map registered to our fixed ROI.

From this overview alone I cannot locate our R239 lower-left ROI by a verified pixel transform, or establish that its broad connected components are a new or already-published reading. I do not infer novelty from failure to recognise a matching region visually.
scope: Visual provenance inspection only. Exact ROI overlap requires documented geometry or an independently checked coordinate correspondence. Image appearance alone neither establishes novelty nor rejects the provisional CT followup candidate.
